paper_title: Millimeter-wave WISP search with coherent Light-Shining-Through-a-Wall towards the STAX project
notes: This is an LSW (light-shining-through-wall) proposal for dark photons (kinetic mixing chi) in the 1e-4 to 1e-3 eV mass range. The paper presents projected (2-sigma) sensitivity curves (Stages A, B, C) in Figs 6-7, not measured limits. As an LSW experiment, no DM density assumption applies. Only a rough sensitivity value (chi~1e-8 around 1e-4 eV from the low-power Stage A text in Eq. 16 region) is given numerically in text; detailed curves are only in figures, not extractable as a table.
